messages:
Sam (Partnerships): Hey team — co-marketing kickoff with CloudAtlas for our integration + marketplace listing. Goal: joint webinar + co-authored blog post + marketplace listing. Timeline ~6 weeks. Who's in?
Maya (Marketing): I'm in. Can we agree the benchmark narrative early? We should have 2 customer examples and a clear performance claim.
Liam (Demand Gen): I'm on registration and routing. Plan: webinar -> gated demo -> MQL. Need landing page + UTM + SFDC mapping.
Priya (Product): Product can provide a demo lane and perf slides. Which integration path do we demo? Suggest flow: onboarding -> low-latency inference -> metrics.
Jenna (Solutions): I'll handle customer speaker asks. Have one customer open to a short on-stage case study.
Sam (Partnerships): Proposed dates: Apr 20 or Apr 27. Which do you prefer?
Maya (Marketing): Apr 27 preferred to give time for benchmark validation and blog draft.
Liam (Demand Gen): Apr 27 works for demand gen calendar. Asset deadline suggestion: Apr 13 (2 weeks prior).
Sam (Partnerships): Action list — Maya: blog + landing copy; Liam: reg page, UTM, SFDC mapping; Priya: demo build & pre-record; Jenna: customer coordination; Sam: partner comms + speaker runbook.
Maya (Marketing): For the benchmark headline I'm proposing: "3x lower latency, 40% lower cost vs baseline" — needs validation. @Priya please confirm p50/p95 numbers.
Priya (Product): Confirm we have traces showing median p50 latency ~220ms -> 75ms on the dedicated config. Cost delta needs finance sign-off.
FinBot: Expense estimate request created: ticket #3421 (Finance).
Liam (Demand Gen): UTM example we should use on all assets: ?utm_source=cloudatlas&utm_medium=partner-webinar&utm_campaign=cld-integ-apr27
Sam (Partnerships): Also ask CloudAtlas to cross-list in their marketplace by Apr 25 — they need a one-pager, logo, and listing copy from us.
Jenna (Solutions): I'll circulate a speaker brief + consent form by EOD today.
Maya (Marketing): Promo plan: 2 email sends, 3 LinkedIn posts (RD + partner), paid social test. Need partner approval on copy by Apr 18.
Sam (Partnerships): Webinar format and hosts: suggest Priya demo + CloudAtlas CMO for panel. Sam to own runbook.
Priya (Product): I can moderate; propose 20-min demo + 15-min panel Q&A. Demo will be 10-min live + 10-min scenario playback.
Liam (Demand Gen): Registration form fields: name, email, company, role, primary use-case checkbox, interested-in-dedicated? -> map those to SFDC lead source fields.
Sam (Partnerships): Routing rule: registrants who attend + express intent -> MQL -> SDR queue tagged partner-integ. Liam please automate workflows.
Liam (Demand Gen): Will configure HubSpot -> SFDC sync and add the workflow. Need SDR distribution list from sales.
Jenna (Solutions): Rehearsals: dry run Apr 24 10:00am PT; tech check Apr 26 11:00am PT. I'll book Zoom and send invites.
Maya (Marketing): Blog outline draft will be ready Apr 10 for internal review — will include benchmark appendix and co-authored intro.
PartnerRep (CloudAtlas): CloudAtlas confirms co-promotion. We'll supply logo + one case study excerpt. Final copy delivery by Apr 19 ok from our side.
Sam (Partnerships): Risks: marketplace listing delays, customer pull-out, partner legal/marketing sign-offs. Contingency: Redwood-only webinar if partner slips.
Maya (Marketing): I'll prepare a short benchmark appendix PDF to attach to the listing and blog.
Priya (Product): Demo env note: provision a read-only token, scrubbed data, prod-like load. No PII.
Sam (Partnerships): Next sync Wed 11:00am PT. I'll create Asana tasks and ping owners.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks everyone :rocket:
